title: Quantum Gravity Could Be Tested Within Decades
description: Many believe quantum gravity will never be observed because it only shows up at the Planck scale. New experimental ideas now aim to detect indirect effects, making tests possible in the coming decades.
narration: QUANTUM GRAVITY IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You think quantum gravity will stay forever beyond experiments, because its effects only appear at the Planck length—10⁻³⁵ meters. In reality, indirect tests could arrive within decades for scientists soon. In the early 21st century, researchers proposed new experiment designs and technologies that make phenomenological quantum gravity feasible, meaning indirect signatures—like tiny deviations in interferometer noise or tabletop graviton‑induced entanglement—could be measured within the next few decades by precision experiments. Soon we may finally watch gravity’s quantum whispers in the lab directly today.
